items.question: How are fixation and the watch-period treated when subjected to a ninefold division?
premises: The terms fixation and watch-period are taken up in sequence.
A division into nine parts is applied.
The division is presented as a condition governing their treatment.
items.inference: Fixation and the watch-period are to be further subdivided into nine parts in the stated sequence.
uncertainties: The precise technical referents of stambha and yāma in this ritual or doctrinal context are not fully determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Then indeed, when divided into nine parts, fixation and the watch-period are treated accordingly.
